panel-tools-001.review_note: Conditional loss of an edited buffer remains urgent. P0 was too strong without a reproduced widespread trigger.

panel-tools-002.review_note: A stale buffer can overwrite an agent's newer disk contents. This is a Ferrite integrity defect. The independent reviewer did not find T3 stale-write protection either, so it is not presented as a verified T3 parity advantage. A clean Markdown preview stayed stale on same-tab revisit after external replacement; close/reopen loaded new disk text. Dirty-buffer overwrite and save-conflict loss were not exercised.

subagents-background-01.review_note: The defect requires an unretained child. The default retains 128 children. The source condition is established, but its frequency and the installed restart path were not reproduced.

subagents-background-03.title: Reopen closed tab restores empty Agent and SideChat tabs
subagents-background-03.review_note: Both paths restore a tab identifier after releasing its backing view. File previews are excluded because their renderer hydrates them on reopen. Both Agent and SideChat close/reopen failures were exercised through real controls. Reopen returns the tab identity with no backing body. File previews remain excluded.

motion-001.title: Sidebar and right-panel geometry snap across structural changes
motion-001.review_note: Both shell width findings share the explicit snap policy. The detailed report retains separate contracts for collapse, reopen, maximize, and width floors. Panel sizing constraints remain a separate finding.

input-focus-001.title: Host action bindings take browser and empty-panel input before their local handlers
input-focus-001.review_note: The same action-before-key-listener boundary also causes input-focus-002. Browser Enter can send the conversation draft and browser Escape can close the surface. The empty-panel branch was reproduced through real GPUI dispatch: Enter sent PANEL_ENTER_SENTINEL and left the launcher open. The browser branch was not exercised in Chromium. This combined record retains source-proven confidence to avoid presenting both branches as runtime-reproduced.

quote-attachments-001.review_note: The user explicitly requires adding their own text to a citation. This is a required workflow gap, not an optional feature candidate. Clean pointer Cite and ordinary composer annotation worked, sending exactly > amber followed by My clean annotation. Clicking the quote tile exposed no editor; typing there was unhandled. This is a per-quote authoring gap, not proof that ordinary text cannot accompany a quote.

coverage-quality-07.review_note: The absence claim remains an inference from bounded repository searches, not proof that every possible external collaboration route is impossible.

input-focus-009.review_note: Cmd+F after clicking the file editor opened transcript Find and highlighted a transcript match in the pinned headless build.

input-focus-010.review_note: Real clicks followed by separate printable keys sent xyz and sam to the main composer; the editor and filter remained unchanged. Failure was visible on the first post-click key.

quote-attachments-012.review_note: The isolated pinned-source build did not reproduce the blanket pointer Cite failure. A clean selection, Cite, ordinary text entry and send succeeded. The installed intermittent symptom remains unresolved, and this verification-gap record stays unverified.

link-affordances-01.review_note: The actual transcript menu showed Open link and Copy link, with no explicit system-browser action. The installed copy-only symptom was not reproduced on this fixture. No browser navigation outcome was tested.

link-affordances-04.review_note: Right-clicking the rendered sample.rs chip opened whole-message Copy, Attach, Pin and Fork actions, with no file-target actions.

link-affordances-06.review_note: Escape left the open link menu visible after real key dispatch. This proves the dismissal failure in the tested state; the broader keyboard-activation claim remains source-proven.

subagents-background-02.review_note: Controlled Main > Alpha > Grandchild rendered nested controls; both nested row and View live output did nothing. This verifies the normal drill failure, not every parent/ancestry/provider path.

subagents-background-08.review_note: Clicking an agent name opened its updated child transcript, but that same row’s View live output opened Background with No output yet. This is a reproduced branch of the inconsistent work/output model; other inventory branches retain source-only status.

panel-tools-018.review_note: The sticky-width branch is runtime-reproduced: Overview 320px becomes 864px after Files/Changes, auto-hides navigation and remains wide through close/reopen and restart at a 1440px window. Narrow-window/manual-drag branches remain unverified.

pr-navigation-01.review_note: Actual production gh discovery in two scratch repositories plus rendered badge clicks reproduced A selected / B clicked / no visible destination. The focused-thread badge was a positive control. CEF page load was not tested.

pr-navigation-02.review_note: Focused sidebar badge opened Browser; the Overview PR row opened the real native Summary and Timeline through production reviewr reads. Other PR entry points remain source-only.

pr-operations-001.review_note: Both menu and palette Refresh PR status left same-number/same-lifecycle detail checks/body/comments stale while lightweight state updated. Re-entry and OPEN→MERGED refresh worked. Agent-action invalidation is not runtime-tested.

composer-02.review_note: A never-sent Cmd+N draft vanished after owned window SIGTERM/restart after autosave; an existing-thread draft persisted and restored as the control. Normal Quit, launch context and attachments were not tested.

composer-04.review_note: Real queued-edit click canceled the queued UUID and combined QUEUED_SENTINEL with UNRELATED_DRAFT. Both texts survived; their independent identities did not. Multi-item and race branches remain untested.

quote-attachments-002.review_note: A roughly 991-character response attached as context was truncated in the 88px tile and could not be inspected by clicking it. Full prose/code still reached the provider. This does not test the >10,000-character attachment limit.

transcript-001.review_note: Find reported no matches for text inside a folded Read call; after disclosure it returned 1/1 for a unique final-passage phrase. Closed-turn search remains source-only. The separate screenshot-only paging blankness is inconclusive because headless repaint omitted unrelated shell regions.

panel-tools-003.review_note: External add/delete left cached children unchanged even after collapse/re-expand. Git status coloring is not runtime-tested.

panel-tools-005.review_note: Eighteen kept inner tabs placed files-tab-17 at x=3250 in a 1440px window without strip navigation. The file tree still activates paths; the failure concerns strip access and hidden close controls.

projects-navigation-001.review_note: Rendered Snoozed-row Rename closed the menu but displayed no editor or rename hint; the stored title remained unchanged. Parked remains source-only. Working-row commit was inconclusive and is not counted as a save failure.

projects-navigation-006.review_note: Opening a broad search after sidebar scrolling retained the old scroll offset with cursor reset to result 0. Visible rows began at 09, but Enter opened the invisible selected result 02. A separate visible-result Down/Enter path worked. Live reordering remains untested.

BROWSER-08.review_note: Parent native observations corroborated the loading branch: Annotate disappeared, Address shifted left and a Loading row appeared above the page. The installed commit is unknown and captures are conversation-only. The source finding remains source-proven; no timing, focus, controlled slow-load or network-error sequence was certified.

pr-navigation-03.review_note: Surface-composition reconciliation corrects prior optional-scope framing: the user explicitly requires an accessible PRs view. A standalone PR browsing destination is required audit repair scope, usable from an empty board or a thread without a current-branch PR. Native forge mutation features remain separate choices. Evidence remains source-proven; no new runtime pass is inferred.
